grammar: - open step | + done step | indent 2 spaces = substep | @context | >YYYY-MM-DD (or >tomorrow >wed: rewritten to a date)

tools.name: abidingsteps
tools.description:
Read and change the user's AbidingSteps task app (outcomes → milestones → steps). One call = one operation. Start with op 'state' (cheap overview), then 'outline' for the outcome you need; avoid listing everything. Name outcomes/milestones/steps by id, exact title, or a unique piece of the title. Steps are note lines: '- open', '+ done', 2-space indent = substep, '@context', '>YYYY-MM-DD' (or >tomorrow, >wed). Every write returns an `undo` id — keep it: undo({id}) reverses that change from any device (once, within 24 h). The `outline` op returns its text in `text`; writes return it in `outline`. Failures always come back as {ok:false,error}. Destructive ops need confirm:true. (start/stop/timer/syncNow need a browser or device running the app; the direct cloud path answers "needs a device".) Returns {ok:true,...} or {ok:false,error,candidates?}.

OPERATIONS (args):
- visions: {} — the user's Vision destinations (long-range, with God): id, title, status (sense|praying|testing|held|released), picture, why, scripture, sessions (count) and lastSession (date) of their private listening journal, and the outcomes serving each. READ-ONLY: these are the user's own words and status; to link an outcome use update {outcome, toward}
- state: {} — one-glance overview: counts per bucket, due steps, up to 5 next-up items, timer, sync
- list: {bucket?, q?, starred?, limit?=25} — outcomes as compact rows
- outline: {outcome? | bucket?} — the notes outline (steps/notes/milestones) as compact text; cheapest way to read an outcome
- agenda: {context?, due?, date?, includeFuture?, limit?=50} — open steps by @context and/or date (what Step's By context / By date show)
- find: {q, limit?=20} — search outcome titles and every step/note line
- add: {title, bucket?, planned?, starred?, type?, tag?, steps?[], notes?} — new outcome
- update: {outcome, toward?(vision id|title|null), title?, starred?, planned?(YYYY-MM-DD|today|tomorrow|weekday|null), bucket?, type?, tag?, maybe?, completed?, budget?:{minutes,per:week|total}|null} — change fields
- addStep: {outcome, text, milestone?, under?, nth?, allowDuplicate?} — append "- text" (add @context and >date inside the text); under = nest beneath that step. A step that already exists in that place is not added again (duplicate:true) unless allowDuplicate:true
- setStep: {outcome, step, done?, milestone?, nth?} — mark a step done (+) or open (-); omit done to toggle; step = its text or a unique piece of it (nth picks one of several identical steps)
- editStep: {outcome, step, text, milestone?} — rewrite a step's text (keeps its - / + and indent)
- removeStep: {outcome, step, milestone?, confirm:true} — delete a step and anything nested under it
- note: {outcome, text, milestone?, under?} — append a plain note line (no - or +)
- setNotes: {outcome, text, milestone?, confirm:true} — REPLACE the whole notes text (the steps live in it)
- addMilestone: {outcome, title, steps?[]} — new milestone
- updateMilestone: {outcome, milestone, title?, done?} — rename or complete a milestone
- removeMilestone: {outcome, milestone, confirm:true} — delete a milestone and its lines
- remove: {outcome, confirm:true} — delete an outcome (undo can bring it back)
- clearDone: {outcome?|bucket?|all?, confirm:true} — delete done steps ("+" lines whose nested lines are all done), done milestones with nothing open, and with all/bucket:Done finished outcomes
- undo: {id? | ids?[], force?} — undo a change by the `undo` id its result returned (works from any device, for ~24 h); several ids undo newest-first; with no id, the last change made on this device (browser/device paths only — the direct-cloud path always needs the id). An undo id works once. Refuses if those items changed since unless force:true
- start: {outcome, minutes?=15, milestone?, step?} — start the Step timer on an outcome / milestone / top-level step (also plans it for today)
- stop: {} — stop the running timer
- timer: {} — is a timer running, and how long is left
- syncNow: {} — push to the cloud right now (other devices pick it up); resolves after the push

args.description: arguments for the op, exactly as shown in the operation list

tools.name: abidingsteps_batch
tools.description: Run several abidingsteps operations in order in ONE round trip (saves tokens/latency). args.ops = [{op, args}, ...]; stopOnError stops at the first failure. Returns {ok:true, results:[...], failed?:[indexes]} in order — ok:true means the batch ran; check `failed`.
